listing.title: Mythical Void
listing.maturityRating: Choose honestly in the current signed-in form; no formal rating is claimed in this pack.
listing.shortDescription: Hatch an alien creature shaped by genetics, cross six damaged realms, rescue their Guardians and decide what the mission tells Earth.
listing.fullDescription: Mythical Void is a free single-player browser adventure. Wanderer-77 has crashed beyond mapped space. Recover what survived, hatch an alien creature shaped by a genetics system, then run, leap, explore and battle through six damaged realms. Rescue the Guardians, build a sanctuary and decide what Project Beacon should tell Earth. The game is in early access and starts with no download or account. Generative AI supports parts of our small Irish studio's creative process, while people remain responsible for the story, safety, testing and what is released. Mythical Void began as a father-and-son project built from imagination, questions and experiments at home. Optional learning moments use credited public NASA material. Mythical Void is independent and is not made, approved or endorsed by NASA.
features: Hatch and name an alien creature shaped by a genetics system.
Run, leap, explore and battle through six different realms.
Rescue corrupted Guardians and bring life back to their worlds.

Play free in a modern browser with no download or account needed to start.

sourceEvidence.finding: Game Jolt's public store guidance says people can filter games by Browser/HTML5, price, maturity and early-access or complete status.

The archived official FAQ says a thumbnail and maturity rating are needed before publication and says the release, package and game page must all be published for discovery. Current signed-in requirements still need confirmation.
The public sign-up page says creating an account accepts the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy. No account action was taken.
The Game API adds optional trophies, scoreboards, sessions and storage. None is needed for the initial page pack and no API or SDK integration is authorised.
